item.title: Will Iowa Democrats reclaim first-in-nation status for caucuses?
item.description: Southwest Iowa Democrats say the caucuses boost the local economy and encourage neighbors to engage in the political process. Others worry that caucuses make it hard for all voters to participate.

item.title: City legal filing claims developer sought agricultural tax break on Civic Auditorium site
item.description: The City of Omaha's response to Civic Corner's lawsuit claims the developer submitted a special valuation application for agricultural or horticultural use.

item.title: Omaha City Council approves $9M financing for contested Dundee development project
item.description: The Omaha City Council approved $9M in TIF funding for the $103M Saddle Creek Marketplace development, despite resident pushback. Plans include demolishing strip malls and closing Family Fare.
